result.summary: The environment is characterized by a wide roadway with multiple embedded streetcar tracks, which present tripping hazards and increase crossing complexity. While sidewalks are present and the intersection is signalized, the lack of high-visibility markings and the significant crossing distance reduce pedestrian safety.

hazards.name: Streetcar Tracks
hazards.description: Multiple sets of tracks embedded in the roadway create uneven surfaces that are tripping hazards for pedestrians and slipping hazards for cyclists.
hazards.location_in_image: Spanning the foreground and middle ground across the entire roadway width.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide intersection increases the duration of exposure to vehicular traffic for pedestrians crossing the street.
hazards.location_in_image: The main intersection area in the middle ground.

hazards.name: Faint Pavement Markings
hazards.description: The existing crosswalk markings are faded, reducing their visibility to approaching motorists.
hazards.location_in_image: At the intersection crossing point in the middle ground.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Replace faded transverse lines with continental-style high-visibility markings to improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the intersection corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve sightlines between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Incorporate a raised refuge island where space permits between tracks and travel lanes to allow for safer two-stage crossings.

result.summary: The image shows a commercial street with a wide, well-maintained sidewalk adjacent to a large building. Pedestrian safety is compromised by a lack of marked crossings and sightline obstructions caused by on-street parking.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Cars
hazards.description: A row of parked vehicles along the curb blocks the line of sight between pedestrians on the sidewalk and drivers on the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the curb in front of the building

hazards.name: Lack of Marked Crossing
hazards.description: There is no visible marked crosswalk in front of the main building entrance, which may lead to unsafe mid-block crossings.
hazards.location_in_image: Roadway in front of the building entrance

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install a marked crosswalk with high-visibility patterns to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces near potential crossing points to ensure clear sightlines.

result.summary: The intersection is equipped with high-visibility ladder-style crosswalks, pedestrian signals, and curb ramps with tactile warning pads. While the infrastructure is modern, the wide roadway and lack of a median refuge island increase pedestrian exposure to vehicle traffic.

hazards.name: Unprotected crossing distance
hazards.description: Pedestrians must cross multiple lanes of traffic without a mid-point refuge island, increasing exposure time.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway at the intersection of 42nd St.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program the traffic signals to give pedestrians a head start before vehicles get a green light, reducing conflicts with turning traffic.

result.summary: The intersection lacks basic pedestrian infrastructure such as marked crosswalks and dedicated pedestrian signals despite having vehicular traffic lights. The presence of streetcar tracks and wide crossing distances increases the risk for pedestrians navigating the area.

hazards.name: Unmarked crossing
hazards.description: No painted crosswalks are visible at the intersection, making pedestrian movements less predictable for drivers.

hazards.name: Streetcar tracks
hazards.description: Embedded tracks in the roadway can be a tripping hazard for pedestrians and a slip hazard in wet conditions.

hazards.name: Lack of pedestrian signals
hazards.description: No dedicated walk/don't walk signals are visible, forcing pedestrians to rely on vehicular lights which may not provide adequate clearance time.

interventions.title: High-visibility crosswalks
interventions.description: Install ladder or zebra-style markings to clearly define pedestrian space and improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Pedestrian countdown signals
interventions.description: Install signals to provide pedestrians with clear information on remaining crossing time.
